== Opening words for the service ==
We are currently working on the seventh liturgical season

: barren worlds... barren worlds
: [place two flat plaster craters on table]

: people, our members...
: [place two model astronauts on the craters]

: practices,  both...
: [move the two models together]

: trees...
: [place a model tree or a plant grown from a seed planted in the first season near the astronauts] 


=== Eric's draft ===
The seventh liturgical season runs from the fall equinox to mid fall (aproximately November 2nd).  It covers the near future, through the SolSeed movement's struggle to achieve the Destiny.  What are the advances of this period?  People.  Practice.  Dyson Trees.  Space Colonies.

<pre>
<Each person begins with a cup of water>

Barren worlds ... everywhere ... barren worlds ...
But here ... <gasp> ... Earth! <-- light earth candle

Cities! Farms! Forests! Seas! 
A living world poised to flower and spread.
A living world supporting a beautiful civilization
A living world, bursting with possibility.

Our story begins with the people, our members ...
We who answer the call! <-- Each person pours their water into a common bowl

As we practice together, a movement forms,
Binding our lives,
Reminding our elephants,
Aligning our words and actions
With our highest aspirations. Each person dips their finger into the common bowl of water and then touches it to their mouth and oposite hand.

We bring the new trees!
The new trees diversify SolSeed,
The new trees colonize barren worlds. < -- third action (lay a floatable tree seed (e.g. individual maple key or pine seed (not whole cone) on the surface of the water)

And ... we grow new homes!
Bringing barren worlds to life,
Colonies of communion for all spacefaring creatures. < -- light second candle the first week and one more each week through the season.

People. Practice. Trees. Colonies.

From barren worlds ... <gasp> ... a family of living worlds.
</pre>

=== Ad experiments/Greenhouses ===

Eric ... if we do Greenhouses, we need to do it to the exclusion of anything else (we wouldn't have energy for developing practices, bringing in more people, etc.) ... the greenhouses are long cycle, and if we do the short cycle thing (bringing in more people) then we can afford to do the long cycle Greenhouse thing (possibly by hiring scientists ... there are many options with more people)

Eric ... we should be kind to ourselves, and although we are excited about the greenhouses we should put them on hold until we have the people and energy and money to do it

Brandon ... can be human labor efficient (current agriculture) or can be space and resources efficient (opposite end of the spectrum from current agriculture)

Eric ... we're close to being ready for a one page plan again, and it should say ... we're not doing greenhouses until we have critical mass (we are building critical mass right now) ... but we will be doing them next!
